github.description: GitHub PR/review operations through github-mcp-rw. Enabled by the owner on 2026-09-02 (MCP-ECOSYSTEM-2b) once cred_github_gateway became active in the Vault inventory; the credential is resolved by reference in lib/mcp-invoke.js and never reaches a task. Flip this flag to disable the outbound half again.

list_pull_requests.description: List open pull requests for a repository.

get_pull_request_diff.description: Fetch the diff for a single pull request.

create_review_comment.description: Post a review comment on a pull request.

create_branch.description: Create a branch from an existing ref. github.write in the permission matrix: CONTROLLED for the executor, so a call needs a GRANTED, unconsumed approval (mcp:github.write). Added 2026-09-02 (MCP-ECOSYSTEM-2b, owner option 1) as the reversible write for the governed end-to-end proof; the branch is removed by hand afterwards because delete_* stays DENY.
